**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

Section 18 of the Cobalt Cloud agreement already carries the full preferred insurance package:

- **CGL** — USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§18.1)
- **Professional E&O** — USD 2,000,000 (§18.1)
- **Cyber and privacy** — USD 5,000,000, imposed unconditionally rather than only where Customer Data is processed, so broader than our model language (§18.1)
- **Workers' compensation** — as required by law, plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra (§18.1)
- **Certificates on request** — plus evidence of relevant coverage (§18.2)

Coverage runs through the term and for one year afterward, at Vendor's expense, and §18.2 adds insurer-quality, primacy, cancellation-notice and non-limitation-of-liability protections that all run in our favour. No redline proposed.
